# Organize dataframe of 2024 amundsen samples for update site figure
```{r}
file1 <- "C:/Users/patri/OneDrive - Université Laval/Laval_Postdoc/Laval-imaging-analysis/UVP6_amundsen2024/export__TSV_15244_20250729_1739/ecotaxa_export__TSV_15244_20250729_1739.tsv"
file2 <- "C:/Users/patri/OneDrive - Université Laval/Laval_Postdoc/Laval-imaging-analysis/UVP6_amundsen2024/export__TSV_14844_20250729_1740/ecotaxa_export__TSV_14844_20250729_1740.tsv"
file3 <- "C:/Users/patri/OneDrive - Université Laval/Laval_Postdoc/Laval-imaging-analysis/UVP6_amundsen2024/export__TSV_14853_20250729_1741/ecotaxa_export__TSV_14853_20250729_1741.tsv"


f1 <- read_tsv(file1) %>% 
  filter(img_rank == 100) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, sample_cruise, sample_ship, sample_stationid, 
           object_lon, object_lat, object_date, sample_bottomdepth) %>% 
  summarise(n_images = n())


f2 <- read_tsv(file2) %>% 
  filter(img_rank == 100) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, sample_cruise, sample_ship, sample_stationid, 
           object_lon, object_lat, object_date, sample_bottomdepth) %>% 
  summarise(n_images = n())


f3 <- read_tsv(file3) %>% 
  filter(img_rank == 100) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, sample_cruise, sample_ship, sample_stationid, 
           object_lon, object_lat, object_date, sample_bottomdepth) %>% 
  summarise(n_images = n())

amund2024_stations <- bind_rows(f1, f2, f3) %>% 
  arrange(-n_images) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, sample_cruise, sample_ship, sample_stationid, 
           object_lon, object_lat, object_date, sample_bottomdepth) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(object_date) %>% 
  mutate(Cruise = "UVP6 Jul-Oct 2024") %>% 
  rename(lon = object_lon, lat = object_lat, botdep = sample_bottomdepth) %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(object_date), Month = month(object_date), 
         Day = day(object_date))
```


# Plot all stations including analyzed sites
This updates the chunk in sentinelle_nord_figures.Rmd
```{r}
library(ggOceanMaps)

# Get addtional metadata
# Check location of potential UVP5 data (calanoida images)
uvp5_ge_side <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/UVP5_greenedge/ecotaxa_export_149_20241018_1551.tsv", sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
uvp5_ge_top <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/UVP5_greenedge/ecotaxa_export_149_20241018_1553.tsv", sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
uvp5_ge <- bind_rows(uvp5_ge_side, uvp5_ge_top)
rm(uvp5_ge_side, uvp5_ge_top)

load("data/LOKI201315_metadata.RData")
load("data/uvp6_lipids_20250410.RData")


# metadata of all stations
meta_stations <- uvp5_ge %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, lon = object_lon, lat = object_lat,
           botdep = sample_bottomdepth, date = object_date, 
           Cruise = "UVP5HD Jun-Jul 2016") %>% 
  bind_rows(uvp6_meta %>% 
              group_by(sample_id) %>% 
              mutate(botdep = max(depth)) %>% 
              ungroup() %>%
              mutate(Cruise = if_else(sample_cruise == "amundsen2023",
                                      "UVP6 Aug-Sep 2023", "UVP6 Oct 2021")) %>% 
              distinct(sample_id, lon, lat, botdep, date, Cruise) ) %>% 
  bind_rows(meta2013, meta2015) %>% 
  bind_rows(amund2024_stations) %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(date),
         Month = month(date),
         DOY = yday(date)) %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year)) %>% 
  mutate(Cruise = factor(Cruise,
                         levels = c("UVP5HD Jun-Jul 2016", 
                                    "LOKI Aug-Sep 2013", "LOKI Apr-Oct 2015",
                                    "UVP6 Oct 2021", "UVP6 Aug-Sep 2023",
                                    "UVP6 Jul-Oct 2024")))



basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = TRUE, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-90,-50,65,83), rotate = 10,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "#eeeac4",  bathy.style = "poly_greys",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA,
        data = df) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = meta_stations,
                                aes(x = lon, y = lat, 
                                    shape = Cruise, color = Cruise),
                                size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("hotpink","gold3","purple2","blue","red3", "orange"), name = "Cruise") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(4,4,4,16,17, 18), name = "Cruise") +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12))+ 
  guides(color  = guide_legend(order = 1),
         shape  = guide_legend(order = 1),
         fill = guide_legend(order = 2))
```
